description: Genuinely unsupported type-representation configurations. Every entry carries a rationale grounded in a production anchor and a witness reference; an entry whose witness status is deferred is an uncovered census cell, not a pass, and is owned by the negative-witness adapters of #2477/#2478. The census validator resolves every present fixture reference against the repository and shape-checks doctest_case references (suite-qualified names); binding those names to a registered TEST_CASE follows with the #2477 adapters.

entries.configuration: A UNION whose member is itself a UNION or a nullable type.
entries.rationale: Union normalization flattens nested unions, hoists nullability onto the union itself, removes duplicates, and canonicalizes order; a set that normalizes to a single alternative is not a union at all and collapses to that alternative (modules/foundry_script/fs_parser.h:247).

witnesses.reference: [Modules][FoundryScript][TypeUnion] A single member collapses to that member

entries.configuration: A static member whose declared type stays open in its declaring class's own type parameters.
entries.rationale: A static member is never copied into subclasses, so an open slot has no sound per-specialization storage; the analyzer rejects the declaration (modules/foundry_script/foundry_script.h:215).

entries.configuration: A generic base or trait named without type arguments in an extends/uses clause.
entries.rationale: A raw generic receiver never binds its parameters, so the parameter is erased to Variant at run time and no argument decides what it holds; the analyzer rejects the bare form rather than binding silently (issue #2310).

entries.configuration: A serialized data-type record whose kind byte exceeds FSDataType::UNION.
entries.rationale: UNION must remain the highest FSDataType::Kind value because the compiled-bytecode loader validates a deserialized kind with kind > UNION; appending a runtime kind requires raising that bound (modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h:82).

witnesses.reference: [FoundryScript][BytecodeHardening] Corrupt and truncated buffers never crash the loader
witnesses.deferred_reason: The hardening suite covers corrupt buffers broadly; a dedicated kind-byte mutation witness belongs to the negative-witness adapters of #2477.

entries.configuration: A transformed Callable whose bind()/bindv() bound more arguments than the fixed-arity target accepts.
entries.rationale: callable_is_over_bound marks such a Callable so that every invocation fails rather than reading past the fixed arity (modules/foundry_script/fs_parser.h:224).

witnesses.reference: [Modules][FoundryScript][GenericTypeModel] Copy and assignment preserve every provenance and identity field
witnesses.deferred_reason: The existing test proves only that the flag survives a copy; an executable invocation-failure witness belongs to the runtime adapters of #2477.

entries.configuration: A serialized data-type record whose width descriptor does not match its carrier's signedness, or exceeds the descriptor range.
entries.rationale: Widths are an explicit wire contract constrained to the INT/UINT carriers; a width the encoder cannot produce is corrupt input, not a type to accept (core/variant/numeric_type.h:39).
